title.narrative: Strengthening education systems in Bangladesh to promote inclusion and equity

description.narrative: The workplan is committed to a multifaceted approach, encompassing the celebration of ILD, WTD, IDE, IMLI, and various other international events. It places a strong emphasis on youth empowerment in rural and crisis-affected areas, addressing digital literacy, financial literacy, basic and functional education, and livelihood skills, in connection with the CLT and CI sectors in terms of the use of MIL and the cultivation of livelihood skills for artists and artisans. It also prioritizes the advancement of MTB-MLE by conducting reviews of textbooks and teacher training modules to ensure effective classroom delivery. Additionally, a pivotal component involves collaborating with the University of Dhaka to organize the Annual Conference on Inclusive Education.
